country_data.national_pork_production_reference_sourc: Botswana Ministry of Agriculture figures reported by BOPA/Daily News at the pig farmers workshop, November 2025
country_data.national_pork_production_reference_note: National industry context: reported pig population 19,010 and annual domestic pork production 1,768 tonnes against demand of 5,000 tonnes (2024/2025 figures). These figures are not farm-level growth rates, liveweight prices, feed costs or production budgets. Local calculator price and full cost inputs remain unverified.
country_data.feed_reference_source: Botswana Public Procurement Regulatory Authority, Price Reference Guide for Animal Feed 2025; Gaborone locality
country_data.feed_reference_note: Official 2025 public-procurement reference prices per 50kg bag for Gaborone. These are dated input-price references, not current retail quotations or a complete per-pig feed budget; not used to overwrite the calculator's benchmark production cost.

lactating_sow_meal.intake_kg_per_day_reference: 2–2.5 in week 1; 7 in weeks 2–8 (as table is rendered in source)

country_data.government_piggery_guide_feed_intake_ref: legacy government guide (hosted 2019-12; original table date not stated)
Government of Botswana, Technical Guide for Establishing a Piggery Project, Feed Requirements and Feed Intake Program (Department of Animal Production)

Botswana-specific feeding-stage and daily intake reference. The guide says feed accounts for about 70% of pig-meat production cost. This is a legacy husbandry reference, not a current feed quotation or complete per-pig cost budget; intake figures are not used to calculate a new selling price or cost_per_unit.
